## Shared per-step PDF reporter
**Skeleton only.** Called once after each executed business step or selected decision branch.
Persist facts → LLM summary (1–2 sentences) → deterministic fallback if needed → append to the run PDF → preserve and return the original result.
The reporter does not log itself recursively. The main workflow sends the final PDF through OpenClaw → Telegram.
**Selected model:** Astra via local LiteLLM. Prompt and data mapping are still pending.

nodes.name: Receive completed step
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Receive run ID, step, sequence/attempt, branch, deterministic result, duration, artifacts, and original pipeline data. Also accept failure/timeout results.

nodes.name: Persist result and redact secrets
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Persist the machine-readable step record first; sanitize any content before passing it to the LLM or PDF.

nodes.name: LLM - summarize in 1–2 sentences
nodes.notes: Disabled skeleton. Uses Astra through the local LiteLLM service. Prompt and input mapping are intentionally pending. Write 1–2 concise English sentences from the sanitized deterministic step result. Preserve pass/fail status; use the existing fallback path on failure.

nodes.name: Summary available and usable?
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Accept a concise summary only if available and consistent with the recorded outcome. Model failure, timeout, or invalid output uses the fallback.

nodes.name: Use deterministic fallback summary
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Use step name, status, and concise recorded error/result when the LLM cannot provide a valid summary.

nodes.name: Append step and save run PDF
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Append this step section in execution order to one report per run and update its PDF immediately. Preserve deterministic status and include repeated attempts. Use an atomic save; retain the structured record if rendering fails for final regeneration.

nodes.name: Return original step result
nodes.notes: Layout placeholder. Return the original pipeline data and branch result unchanged, with the report reference. Reporting must not alter decision outcomes.

nodes.name: Astra - LiteLLM (summary)
nodes.notes: Configured model: astra → chatgpt/gpt-6-astra. Direct internal endpoint http://litellm-database:4000/v1 on Podman network core. The credential is stored only in local n8n; its LiteLLM key is limited to astra. No proxy or external URL is involved.

main.node: Append step and save run PDF
Append step and save run PDF
